output:
**No, not as a rename of the bundle identifier.** The repo's release rules mark `is.waiwai.dictation` as permanent because existing Accessibility grants depend on it. Changing it would make macOS treat the app as new, so users would have to re-grant permission. Sparkle updates also expect the bundle identifier to stay the same.

The simpler path is to keep `is.waiwai.dictation` and change only the user-facing name to OpenRamble (display name and product name). If you do want the new identifier, the permanence rule in the repo needs to change first.
